# 00000001899

**ML-29 ★** — source: 48_逻辑与模型论II.md

**English.** Conjecture: The realizable values of the hypergraph compactness number (the first infinite compactness cardinal) form an explicit transfinite-recursive sequence (generated by alternating ℵ_n and ℵ_{ω·n}); the sequence is recursive via the Mahlo-type closure of the PCF ladder, and no other values occur.

**中文。** 猜想：超图紧性数(第一无穷紧性数)的可实现值为超限递归的显式序列(由 ℵ_n 与 ℵ_{ω·n} 交替生成);序列由 PCF 阶梯的 Mahlo 型闭包递推,不出现其他值。
